purpose: Let the artist hear verified local managed audio attached to canonical Song Versions from the normal /song Version history, using opaque local read authority and bounded byte-range delivery, while degrading external, unsupported or integrity-failed material truthfully and without changing current/approved/history state.

lineage.outcome: The artist can hear a preserved local audio Version before deciding what to resume or later approve, without leaving Song context or depending on a DAW/provider.
lineage.capability: Verified local managed Version audio audition

why_now: PR #54 landed consumer-visible Version history and reversible resume. The canonical SCOPE_LEDGER marks REQ-SCOPE-010 Try→Hear→Compare→Decide as a required signature loop and says the immediate musical interaction loop remains incomplete. Approval/decision UI would now be premature because the artist still cannot hear the owned alternatives. Live N0TE2 search finds no clean-room audition implementation, so the smallest honest next bridge is local verified audio playback rather than pretending analysis, loudness-aware A/B or provider generation already exists.
instead_of: Approval/keep/reject UI is not selected because a consequential decision should not be made from filenames and labels when owned audio can be made hearable first.
Full loudness-aware A/B is not selected because no loudness-analysis/normalization substrate exists in clean-room N0TE2 yet.
Musical derivation is not selected because tempo/chord/section/audio-analysis engines are still absent from the live clean-room destination.

Full Song-first Creative Studio is not selected because transport/timeline/direct-manipulation is a larger convergence slice; local Version audition is a smaller prerequisite that gives the existing history immediate musical meaning.
Another DAW chassis increment is not selected because hearing N0TE-owned Song material is host-independent and directly closes the current Try→Hear gap.

n0te2_dependencies: SONG-01C SongMaterialMemory managed immutable blobs and integrity verification

completion_proof: each browser-auditionable verified managed audio Asset in the active Song's Version history receives an artist-facing audio control through an opaque server-owned local URL
the media URL carries no raw Song/Version/Asset/profile ID, managed URI or filesystem path and is valid only for the currently rendered local shell authority
media reads revalidate active Song, Version-to-Asset membership, managed-material integrity and supported audio signature before bytes are served
external references, unsupported formats, missing/tampered managed blobs and cross-Song/stale authority never return creative bytes and render truthful unavailable/protected state
full GET plus valid single byte-range GET return correct content type, length and Content-Range semantics; malformed/unsatisfiable/multiple ranges fail closed
audition GETs are read-only: Song current/approved pointers, Version/Asset lineage, Sessions, Focus and Operations remain unchanged
navigation and Quit/relaunch regenerate opaque audition authority while the same managed Version remains hearable
authored HTTP/security/invariant/restart tests remain separate from executed evidence; absent hosted execution is UNOBSERVED
next_selection_rule: After this increment lands or blocks, globally reselect. Compare consequential decision/approval reachability, fuller Try→Hear→Compare loop, Song-first Creative Studio, truthful audio-analysis substrate, suggestions/templates, DAW/OPS and other portfolio outcomes. Do not continue by label adjacency.
